{{Quote|Looks like somebody left the doors of the Academy wide open. I have a bad feeling about this.|[[Atton Rand]]|<ref name="KotORII game" />}}
During the [[First Jedi Purge]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Meetra Surik]] was forced to '''duel''' the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sion]] when [[Gender/Legends|he]] attacked her in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Did you come here for answers? There are none. The call of Korriban is strong, but it is the call of the dead.|Darth Sion, to Meetra Surik|audio=SionAnswers.flac|<ref name="KotORII game" />}}
In the chaos following the [[Jedi Civil War]], which nearly destroyed the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lonna Vash]] used Korriban as a hideout. Enraged that [[Kreia]] would sacrifice herself for Surik when she was so much weaker than himself, Sion grew determined to destroy all Kreia held dear, including Surik. He got his chance to catch her when she came to Korriban in search of [[Lonna Vash]]. Shortly after Surik arrived on Korriban, Sion killed the imprisoned [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Surik and two of her companions went in search of Master Vash on the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] homeworld of Korriban. After Kreia telepathically guided her through the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]], she entered the abandoned Sith Academy. When Surik had entered the ruins of the Sith Academy; Sion sensed her arrival and had the doors to the Academy sealed behind her, as he sent [[Sith assassin/Legends|his assassins]] in pursuit of her and her companions. As Surik wandered the emptied academy, encountering only [[Tuk'ata/Legends|tuk'ata]] and cloaked Sith assassins of the [[Sith Triumvirate]], she found Vash's corpse inside the interrogation room. Surik unlocked the Academy entrance, but Sion moved to block their escape, at last coming face to face with her. He told her that he studied and "immersed" himself in her, and that he knew of the paths she walked in [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]]. He said that he knew her teacher, Kreia, and of [[Battle of Dxun|the fires that raged on Dxun while the Republic died around her]]. Sion further stated that she knew of war and battle, and said that [[Battle of Malachor V|he knew of Malachor]]. Sion said that Surik knew what it meant to be broken, and warned her that Kreia would destroy her as she had destroyed him and said that he could end her suffering at Kreia's hands before it began.

==The Duel==
{{Quote|Sion. He cannot be defeated... he is not a beast of flesh and blood. This is not a battle that can be won. Flee.''"<br />"''Thanks for the information.''"<br />"''There will be another time. But it is not now, not here, while Korriban runs through him.|Kreia informs Meetra Surik about Lord Sion|<ref name="KotORII game" />}}
{{GameLS}}
With these words, Surik and her companions fought the Lord of Pain, striking him down multiple times. However, the Dark Lord would call upon the Force to restore his health to recover from the fatal injuries and keep fighting. Through the Force, Kreia informed Surik that Sion was not a beast of flesh and blood, and that it was not a battle that could be won. She told her that while there would be another opportunity, now was not the right time—not while Korriban ran through Sion. Surik thanked Kreia for the information, and she and her companions fled the Sith Academy.
{{Endgame}}

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Do not harm her. I command it. She... has earned this. She and I will meet again.|Sion allowing Meetra Surik to flee|<ref name="KotORII game" />}}
Surik and her companions fled the Academy, and Sion, feeling a measure of respect for her, let her go, ordering his assassins not to harm her. He expected they would meet again. Sion soon began to feel a new emotion for Surik beyond respect or admiration, one that he could not tolerate. The Sith Lord found her beautiful, but he saw in these feelings weakness that would only lead to death. As she continued to dominate his thoughts, Sion grew to hate her for it. After escaping the trap, Surik discovered the long lost [[Tomb of Ludo Kressh|tomb]] of [[Ludo Kressh]].
